ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers streaming, so this older model offers little benefit.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K Max bundle and have no current need for another streaming stick.
ItemID: 3; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my history of memory cards and card readers, but I would wait until I need more storage.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Echo Show purchase covers my interest in an Alexa screen, and this older tablet has no clear role right now.
ItemID: 5; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It could be useful with my TV and Blu-ray equipment, but I do not currently need a ten-foot cable.
ItemID: 6; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An HD streaming stick would add little to my existing 4K Max setup.
ItemID: 7; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home electronics and computer accessories, with no current need for wired earbuds.
ItemID: 8; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added a fourth-generation Echo Dot and an Echo Show 5, so another older speaker feels redundant.
ItemID: 9; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB UHS-I/Class 10 Micro SDHC Memory Card With Adapter - SDSDQUAN-032G-G4A; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It is compatible with my interest in removable storage, but I have no immediate reason to buy another card.
ItemID: 10; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add voice control to a lamp and make practical use of my recent Echo devices.
